title: Virtual Operations Assistant | Be My Right Hand & Keep Everything Moving
description:
We’re looking for an experienced, highly organised and proactive Virtual Operations Assistant to work directly with the business owner across a fast-paced group of businesses and clients.



This is not a basic admin role.



I need someone who can become my right hand — someone who can manage information coming at us from multiple directions, keep workflows moving, coordinate with staff, follow things up and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We work across multiple businesses and industries, so every day can look different. You need to be someone who enjoys variety, learns quickly and can confidently jump between priorities.



What you'll be doing:



Managing and monitoring a high-volume
 inbox

Reviewing incoming
s and redirecting/delegating work to the appropriate team member

Flagging urgent or important matters for my attention

Following up outstanding
s, tasks and client requests

Managing workflows and ensuring jobs are progressing and completed

Liaising with bookkeeping, administration and other team members

Assisting with new client onboarding and ensuring everything required is collected and set up

Maintaining client records, systems and internal processes

Helping develop and improve procedures and workflows

Tracking deadlines and outstanding work

Preparing correspondence and responding to routine enquiries

Identifying bottlenecks or problems before they become bigger issues

Assisting me with whatever needs to be done to keep the businesses moving



Who I'm looking for:



You need to be experienced. I'm not looking for someone who needs to be taught basic administration or how to manage their workload. I need someone who is ready to go!!!



I'm looking for someone who:



Has experience working remotely in a busy professional environment

Is comfortable managing high volumes of work across multiple clients and industries

Is exceptionally organised

Communicates clearly and professionally

Can prioritise without needing constant direction

Is confident liaising with other staff and following up work

Learns new software and systems quickly

Is comfortable improving processes rather than simply following them

Takes ownership of tasks and follows them through to completion

Can adapt when priorities suddenly change

Isn't afraid to ask questions when something doesn't make sense

Understands confidentiality and dealing with sensitive client information



Most importantly, I want someone who sees something that needs doing and thinks “I'll sort that”, rather than waiting to be told every individual step.



This role has the potential to become a significant and trusted position within the business for the right person.



If you're highly organised, love creating order from chaos and enjoy being the person behind the scenes who keeps everything running, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations Manager (Home Services) - $6-11/hr - Full-Time - Must Work Central Time - Video Intro Required
description:
WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR A GENERAL VA. WE ARE HIRING AN OPERATIONS MANAGER.



If you're looking for a task-based, "tell me what to do" VA job — this isn't it. If you want to own a real function of a real business, keep reading.



30A Window Washing is a growing home services company based in Florida. We're scaling aggressively and need someone who can run the back-end operations of the business — not just support it.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

- Scheduling and dispatching technicians

- Managing unpaid invoices and following up on collections

- Handling job reschedules and last-minute changes

- Client communication 
, text, phone) — you'll represent our brand directly to customers

- CRM management

- Keeping the day-to-day operation moving without me having to check in



THIS IS NOT ENTRY-LEVEL. HERE'S WHAT'S REQUIRED:



- 8/10 English or higher, spoken and written. You will be talking to American clients directly. If your English isn't strong, please don't apply — this isn't a knock on you, it's just not the right fit.



- CRM experience required. You must have hands-on experience running a CRM — ideally for a home service business (HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, pest control, cleaning, pool service, etc.). You don't need window cleaning experience specifically, but you need to have actually managed scheduling, dispatch, or invoicing inside a CRM before.



- 40+ hours/week, and you must work Central Time (US) business hours. This is a real job, not a side gig. We need someone reliably available when our clients and technicians are.



- Proactive, not reactive. I don't want to have to tell you what to do every day. I want someone who sees a problem and solves it, or flags it before it becomes one. Ownership mindset — this is your department, not my to-do list for you.



- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a real computer. No exceptions.



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $6-11/hr depending on experience and English level, paid [weekly / bi-weekly]

- Long-term, full-time position with real room to grow as the company scales

- Direct access to leadership — you'll work closely with the owner, not buried under five layers of management

- The opportunity to genuinely run something, not just execute tasks



---



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY. Applications that don't follow these exact instructions will not be considered. This is intentional — I need to know you follow directions before I trust you with client communication.



1. Your application subject/first line must read exactly:

OPS MANAGER — [Your Name] — [Your English Self-Rating 1-10]



2. Answer these questions in your application:

- Describe a CRM you've used and what specific tasks you managed in it (scheduling, invoicing, dispatch, etc.)

- Tell me about a time a client or customer was upset. What did you do?

- What does "ownership mindset" mean to you, in your own words?

- Do you have an Iphone

- Do you have stable internet / VPN if needed



3. Record a 60-90 second video (Loom or your phone camera) introducing yourself IN ENGLISH, telling me why you're the right fit. Attach the link.



NO VIDEO = NO CONSIDERATION, regardless of how strong your resume is.



If you've read this far and you're still interested, start your application with the word "RELIABLE" so I know you actually read the whole post.

title: DIGITAL PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
Great campaigns need more than good ideas. They need someone who can keep the work moving when there are multiple clients, competing deadlines, missing inputs, and several people involved in every deliverable.



Leads Global is looking for a Digital Project Coordinator who wants to become the person a marketing team can rely on when work gets busy. You will work at the centre of client delivery, helping turn ideas into organised, on-time execution across copy, creative, paid media, landing pages, and campaign implementation.



This is a strong career opportunity for someone with hands-on social media or digital marketing experience who is ready to move into project coordination. You will not be expected to be a senior manager on day one. You will be given real responsibility, clear standards, and the opportunity to grow into a capable project-management professional.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will manage the daily flow of client work in Basecamp. You will make sure every task has a clear owner, due date, next action, and enough context for the assigned person to begin without guessing.



You will coordinate across copywriters, designers, media buyers, developers, and contractors. You will follow up before deadlines become a problem, identify what is missing, and help remove obstacles so the team can deliver quality work on time.



When an issue needs a decision, you will raise it early and clearly. When a client needs an update, you will help prepare communication that is calm, accurate, and useful. Your work will make it easier for everyone else to focus on doing excellent work.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



You have practical experience in social media, digital marketing, content coordination, paid media support, or a creative/digital agency. You understand the basics of how marketing campaigns are built and why small details can make the difference between a smooth launch and a stressful one.



You are the person who notices when something does not add up. You keep track of details, follow through on what you say you will do, and prefer to solve a problem while it is still small. You can manage several moving parts without losing the larger picture.



You communicate clearly in written English. You are comfortable asking precise questions, following up professionally, and giving others the information they need to do their best work. You are open to feedback, eager to learn, and serious about building a long-term career in digital project coordination.



Experience with Basecamp is a plus. Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Trello, Notion, or similar tools is also useful. Familiarity with Meta Ads, Google Ads, social media content, campaign assets, landing pages, or funnel work will be an advantage.



We use AI tools to improve speed and quality across the business. We value people who can use AI intelligently while maintaining good judgement, checking details, and taking responsibility for the final outcome.



WHY LEADS GLOBAL



You will be part of a team that cares about doing thoughtful work well. We value integrity, clear communication, continuous improvement, and measurable marketing results. You will receive practical exposure to real client delivery and a clear pathway to grow your project-management capability as you prove yourself.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form: 



Qualified applicants will receive a practical assessment. It is designed to show how you approach project coordination, competing deadlines, incomplete information, and client communication.

title: ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR — U.S. BUSINESSES
description:
ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR — U.S. BUSINESSES



Full-Time | 9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time | $8–$10/hour + $30–$50 Per Qualified Meeting Held



This is not an entry-level cold-calling job.



We're a U.S.-based IT asset disposition, e-waste recycling, and data destruction company looking for one genuinely excellent B2B lead generator to join our Philippine-based team.



If you're confident on the phone, communicate exceptionally well with U.S. professionals, think on your feet, and consistently turn cold prospects into real opportunities, we want to hear from you.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes 100 calls and reads a script.



We want someone who builds pipeline — including with prospects who may not need us today but will six months from now.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Call U.S. businesses and speak with IT managers, office managers, facilities managers, owners, and other decision-makers.



You'll identify IT recycling, data destruction, and equipment disposition opportunities; qualify and book meetings for our sales team; follow up by phone and
; re-engage older leads; and maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps.



WHAT WE NEED



-2+ years of successful B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

-Substantial experience calling U.S. businesses

-Exceptionally clear, natural spoken English — U.S. prospects should understand you easily and without effort

-Strong objection-handling and conversational skills

-Persistence without being pushy

-Strong organization and follow-up habits

-Ability to work independently and take ownership of results



IT services, MSP, SaaS, telecom, technology, or recycling experience is a plus.



Zoho and Dialpad experience are helpful but not required. We'll teach the software to the right salesperson.



COMPENSATION



$8–$10/hour base, based on experience



PLUS a tiered monthly bonus for every qualified meeting that is actually held:



-1–9 meetings: $30 each

-10–14 meetings: $40 each

-15+ meetings: $50 each



Crossing a tier raises ALL qualified meetings held that month to the higher rate.



Examples:



-9 meetings = $270

-10 meetings = $400

-15 meetings = $750



There is no cap.



Strong performers can realistically earn $1,800–$2,400+ per month.



A qualified meeting means you reached the right business contact, identified a legitimate current or foreseeable need, and the prospect genuinely agreed to meet with our sales team.



You do not need to establish budget or timeline — that's our sales team's job.



No bonus for calendar stuffing, unqualified meetings, or no-shows.



Once a meeting is legitimately qualified and held, it's paid.



FORMER EMPLOYER REFERENCE — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Before any offer is made, we must personally speak with at least one former supervisor, manager, or business owner who directly managed your B2B calling or appointment-setting work.



A coworker, personal reference, or HR-only employment verification will not substitute.



We will only contact the reference once you are a finalist.



If you cannot provide this reference, please do not apply.



HOW TO APPLY



Use exactly 12 Apply Points. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Please answer:



-How many years of B2B calling experience do you have, including experience calling U.S. businesses?

-What industries have you called?

-In your most recent role, approximately how many qualified meetings did you book each month, and how many actually held?

-What CRM and calling platforms have you used?

-What hourly rate are you seeking?



REQUIRED: 60–90 SECOND RECORDING



Include a Loom, Vocaroo, or similar voice/video recording created specifically for this application. No generic introduction you've sent to multiple employers.



Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared answer.



Tell us:



-Your name

-Your recent B2B calling experience

-One specific cold call from the last few months that didn't go as expected and what you did



Do not perform a scripted sales pitch.



If we interview you, you'll be given live cold-call situations and objections you have not seen in advance.



Subject: ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR – [Your Name]



We're hiring one person.



If you're genuinely excellent at generating B2B opportunities and want your compensation tied directly to performance, we want to hear from you.

title: Client Care and Inside Sales Coordinator: $6 Per Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager



Job Description



Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Voice Recording Required to Apply



Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post.



Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Do you love providing excellent service in a support based role?



Do you thrive in a fast paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!



About Boulder Pro Painters



Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.



We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and taking care of our amazing team members by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.



We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.



Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and producing great results.



In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business.



This is an important, long term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.



Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing



We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.



This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:



* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.



* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.



* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.



* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates.



* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.



* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.



* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.



* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.



* Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our
 and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile.



* Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers.



* Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms.



* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow up activities.



* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.



* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.



* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business.



As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:



* Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services.



* Reconnecting with past customers about future projects.



* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.



* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners.



* Supporting customers after their project is approved.



* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.



* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.



* Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems.



* Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow up reports.



* Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records.



* Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows.



 Who We Are Looking For: About You



* You thrive in a fast paced work environment.



* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.



* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.



* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.



* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.



* People say you have great energy. You’re a positive, optimistic person.



* You’re a go getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.



* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.



* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.



* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.



* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.



* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.



* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.



* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



* You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy.



* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.



* You want a stable, long term position where you can grow with the company.



* You are available to transition into a full time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.



* You have reliable high speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.



* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States based company is preferred.



Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software,
, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required.



We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



Compensation and Job Details



* This is a remote, long term position for candidates located in the Philippines.



* The position will begin with a paid 30 day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.



* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.



* The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.



* The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.



* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full time.



* Full time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one hour unpaid meal break.



* The current corresponding full time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.



* Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.



* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.



* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed.



* To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner.



* The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member.



* You’ll be paid twice per month.



* Paid training is included.



* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.



* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90 day review.



* You will receive prorated 13th month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.



* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days.



* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.



* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.



This is more than a short term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.



Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.



Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?



We’d love to hear from you.



To Apply, Please Submit All Eight Items



1. A cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position and why you believe you are the person we are looking for.



2. Your current résumé.



3. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer service, inside sales, office administration, or social media experience.



4. Confirmation that you can work the initial part time schedule and transition into the required full time Mountain Time schedule.



5. Your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.



6. A description of your internet connection and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



7. Confirmation of whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers. If yes, include your current working schedule.



8. Your brief answer to this question:



A homeowner requested an estimate but did not answer your first call. What would you do next?



Before submitting, confirm that all files and links work and that anyone with the link can access them.



Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Best,



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

title: Admin Manager (Home Services) - $6-11/hr - Full-Time - Must Work Central Time - Video Intro Required
description:
WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR A GENERAL VA. WE ARE HIRING AN ADMIN MANAGER.



If you're looking for a task-based, "tell me what to do" VA job — this isn't it. If you want to own a real function of a real business, keep reading.



30A Window Washing is a growing exterior cleaning home services company based in Florida. We're scaling aggressively and need someone detail-obsessed to run the administrative and financial backbone of the business. This isn't just a short term gig position we are looking to fill, we are shooting to be the fastest growing company in our industry and need the best of the best, A Player talent to be apart of the team, given the growth rate of the company there is vast amounts of growth potential for this position as well.



This role works closely under our Operations Manager and is a critical second seat in our back office — not a lesser role, just a different lane. If you're precise, financially minded, and love clean systems more than you love chaos, this is your job.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

- Running payroll

- Bookkeeping and financial record-keeping in QuickBooks

- Making sure every client profile in our CRM is set up correctly and completely

- Making sure every job is marked/logged correctly (completed, invoiced, paid, etc.)

- General financial organization and reporting support

- Personal assistant tasks for the owner as needed (scheduling, research, misc. admin support)



THIS IS NOT ENTRY-LEVEL. HERE'S WHAT'S REQUIRED:



- 8/10 English or higher, spoken and written. You'll be communicating with our team and occasionally clients directly. If your English isn't strong, please don't apply — this isn't a knock on you, it's just not the right fit.



- QuickBooks experience required. You must have real, hands-on experience running payroll and bookkeeping inside QuickBooks. This is not optional — if you haven't used QuickBooks specifically, please don't apply.



- CRM experience preferred. Experience keeping client records and job records clean and accurate inside a CRM (home services industry a plus, but not required).



- 40+ hours/week, and you must work Central Time (US) business hours. This is a real job, not a side gig.



- Detail-obsessed and organized. This role lives and dies by accuracy. If a client profile is wrong or a job is marked incorrectly, it creates real problems downstream. We need someone who catches their own mistakes before anyone else has to.



- Proactive, not reactive. If you see something off in the books, in the CRM, or in a client account, we want you to flag it or fix it — not wait to be told.



- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a real computer. No exceptions.



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $690-$1,560/month (approx. $4-9/hr) depending on experience and English level, paid [weekly / bi-weekly]

- Long-term, full-time position with real room to grow as the company scales

- Direct access to leadership — you'll work closely with our Operations Manager and the owner

- A stable, structured role where your accuracy and reliability are genuinely valued



---



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY. Applications that don't follow these exact instructions will not be considered. This is intentional — I need to know you follow directions before I trust you with our financials.



1. Your application subject/first line must read exactly:

ADMIN MANAGER — [Your Name] — [Your English Self-Rating 1-10]



2. Answer these 3 questions in your application:

- Describe your experience with QuickBooks — specifically, what did you handle (payroll, invoicing, reconciliation, reporting, etc.)?

- Tell me about a time you caught a mistake (yours or someone else's) before it became a bigger problem. What did you do?

- What does "accuracy" mean to you in a job like this, in your own words?



3. Record a 60-90 second video (Loom or your phone camera) introducing yourself IN ENGLISH, telling me why you're the right fit. Attach the link.



NO VIDEO = NO CONSIDERATION, regardless of how strong your resume is.



If you've read this far and you're still interested, start your application with the word "PRECISE" so I know you actually read the whole post.

title: Creative Strategist for Scaling DTC Brand
description:
READ THIS FIRST: To apply, start your message with the word ANGLE. Applications without it get deleted unread. We do this to find people who actually pay attention to detail.



## About Us



We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands (beauty). We move fast, test constantly, and live and die by our ad creative. We're not a corporate agency. You'll work directly with the founder, get quick feedback, and see your concepts go live in real campaigns within days.



## The Role



You'll own the front of the funnel: research → angles → hooks → briefs → iteration. You d
 what we make and why, not just how it's cut. This is performance strategy, not "brand vibes." You're measured on ROAS and CPA, not on how clever a concept sounds in a meeting. You'll turn customer research and competitor teardowns into a steady pipeline of testable ad concepts that actually scale.



## What You'll Do



- Research markets, customers, reviews, and competitors to find the angle

- Write hooks, scripts, and shot-by-shot briefs for editors and UGC creators

- Own the creative testing roadmap — what we test next, and why

- Read the data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and d
 what to double down on or kill

- Turn winners into fresh angles, formats, and variations for testing (not lazy re-cuts)

- Direct editors and creators, and QC that the output matches the concept

- Keep a swipe and insight library so we're never starting from zero



## Must-Haves (track record required)



- 2+ years as a creative strategist for DTC/e-commerce (health/wellness or beauty strongly preferred) with Trackrecord

- You can point to specific winning ads/angles YOU conceived — and the numbers they hit

- Deep direct-response instincts: awareness levels, angles, mechanisms, hooks, offers

- You understand the full funnel — ad → advertorial/VSL/landing page → conversion

- Comfortable reading an ad account and forming a POV, not waiting to be told

- Strong written English — briefs a creator or editor can execute without 10 follow-ups

- High volume and fast iteration don't scare you



## Nice-to-Have



- Hands-on with AI creative tools (Higgsfield, Runway, ElevenLabs, Topaz, etc.)

- Can rough-cut or storyboard your own concepts

- Worked directly with media buyers on scaling accounts

- Familiar with advertorial and VSL structures



## Hours & Growth



Start at 20 hrs/week. If your angles win and you're reliable, this grows into more hours, a higher rate, and more ownership. We keep good people long-term.



## How to Apply (follow exactly — this is the test)



1. Start your message with ANGLE

2. Link a portfolio or case docs of ads/angles you concepted — concepts + results, not pretty edits you didn't strategize

3. In 3–4 sentences: pick your best-performing angle, the research/insight behind it, why the hook worked, and the result (ROAS / CPA / spend scaled — real numbers)

4. Tell us your process for finding a brand-new angle from scratch

5. List the tools you use (research, briefing, AI, analytics)

6. Confirm your weekly availability and timezone

7. how long youre in Creative Strategy already and track record



Applications that skip any step, hide the numbers, or lead with a generic "I'm hardworking and passionate" intro will not be reviewed.

We have some existing reusable systems (economy, gacha mechanics, UI, monetization, and more) from an earlier project that can be reused or adapted, but there's real room to build new systems, improve on what exists, and even help shape new game ideas, this isn't a rigid, locked-in process.

title: Tax Preparer (Part-Time | Remote | Seasonal)
description:
Position: Tax Preparer (Part-Time | Remote | Seasonal)

Location: Remote

Hours: Part-time, seasonal (tax season)

Compensation: TBD

Type: 1099 Subcontractor



================================================



Looking for meaningful tax work with a firm that actually thinks strategically?



Join a small, focused remote team where your attention to detail and technical skills directly impact real clients building real wealth.



================================================

ABOUT US

================================================



At OpenPath Finance, we help business owners, Bitcoiners, and freedom-minded entrepreneurs take control of their finances, reduce their tax burden, and build lasting wealth.



We're not here just to file returns. We work closely with clients year-round to strategically plan their tax and financial operations and ensure those plans are reflected in their books and filings. We care about the details because they drive real results.



We're a small, focused team that values thoughtful action, steady progress, and full ownership of our work. We're not looking for perfection, but we do look for people who take initiative, ask smart questions, and follow through.



If you're someone who pursues purpose, embraces growth, and wants to contribute to meaningful work with real impact, you'll feel right at home here. Learn more at 
.



================================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

================================================



We're hiring a Tax Preparer to join our team during tax season. You'll be assigned a mix of personal and business returns to prepare, and you'll also serve as the first-level reviewer on your teammate's work before anything reaches the firm owner and tax advisor.



The goal is simple: by the time a return reaches the tax advisor for final sign-off, it has been prepared carefully and reviewed thoroughly. His role is a quick final check, not a detailed review. That standard is on you and your teammate to uphold together.



This is a technical, detail-oriented role with real accountability. You'll work independently, manage your own queue, and communicate clearly when something needs escalation.



================================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

================================================



- Prepare assigned U.S. tax returns accurately and on time, including complex 1040s, 1065s, and 1120-S returns

- Perform first-level peer review on teammate's prepared returns before submission to firm owner

- Document review notes clearly so the final reviewer can move quickly and confidently

- Meet turnaround standard: returns must be finalized within two weeks of receiving a completed organizer

- Communicate proactively when client information is missing, unclear, or when a return requires escalation

- Follow firm workflows in TaxDome and prepare returns in Drake



================================================

REQUIREMENTS

================================================



- 5+ years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation and review experience

- Strong technical knowledge of complex Forms 1040, 1065, and 1120-S, 1120

- Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based CPA firm or tax practice

- Proficient in Drake Tax software

- Communicates clearly and professionally in written English -- client-facing communication is a core part of this role, including status updates, document requests, and follow-up questions

- Works independently, meets deadlines, and follows through without being chased

- Available during U.S. business hours, with morning Central Time availability required for weekly tea
etings and working sessions with their team pod



================================================

PREFERRED

================================================



- Experience reviewing others' tax work, not just preparing

- Familiarity with TaxDome or similar tax workflow platforms

- Knowledge of Bitcoin, Bitcoin mining, and related tax and accounting considerations



================================================

GROWTH PATH

================================================



This starts as a seasonal, part-time engagement. For the right person, there is a clear path to increased hours, year-round work, and a more senior role within the firm as we grow. We invest in people who take ownership and grow with us.



================================================

HOW TO APPLY

================================================



To apply, click the Apply button and include the following in your message:



1. A link to your resume (Google Docs or Dropbox)

2. A short note -- no more than 2 paragraphs -- on why this role interests you and what kind of tax work you've handled most

3. Answer this question in 3-5 sentences: Describe a time you caught a significant error in a tax return, whether your own or someone else's. What was it and how did you handle it?



We review written responses first. Strong communicators who demonstrate real tax experience will move to the next stage.

title: FULL TIME & TOP PAY --- Business Development & Outreach VA | Cold Calling + Marketing
description:

Full-Time | Remote | 5-9 USD Per Hour



PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST AND FOLLOW ALL APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



We are a growing restoration and construction company in Arizona looking for a smart, outgoing, resourceful Virtual Assistant to help us generate new business and build relationships with potential customers and referral partners.

This is not a web design position, and we are not looking for someone whose primary strength is sitting behind a computer building websites or funnels.

The main goal of this position is simple:



Help us create more conversations, build more relationships, generate more opportunities, and ultimately sell more jobs and bring in more customers.



We want someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, communicating with people, following up consistently, using different forms of outreach, and thinking creatively about new ways to generate business through your assignments..

You will have systems and processes to follow that have been tested but we always welcome critical thinking and suggestions if you find a better approach to something.



We want someone who can think.

Someone who asks:

How can we get more people to respond?

What could we say differently?

How can we improve this campaign?

What follow-up are we missing?

Can AI or technology help us do this better?

What other opportunities should we be pursuing?

What You'll Be Doing

A large part of your role will involve outbound lead generation and relationship building.



You Will Be:

Making outbound cold calls

Follow up with leads by phone, text,
, and social media

Contact potential customers

 marketing through Go High Level (GHL)

Track results and identify what's working

You MUST be comfortable picking up the phone and talking to strangers.

You don't need to be an aggressive salesperson. In fact, we would rather have someone who is personable, curious, confident, and good at having natural conversations.



But if cold calling makes you uncomfortable, this position is probably not for you.

We Want Someone Who Can Think Creatively

We want someone who pays attention.



For example:

If people aren't answering, what else could we try?

If a certain message gets more responses, how can we use that?

If you find a better way to research prospects, follow up, automate repetitive work, or organize leads, bring us the idea.

You will be encouraged to test ideas, make suggestions, and help us improve.



Excellent English Is Extremely Important

You will represent our company when communicating with potential customers and business partners.

You need to speak English clearly, naturally, confidently, and professionally.

You should be comfortable having an unscripted conversation with an American customer or business owner.

Strong written English is also important because you may communicate through:


SMS

LinkedIn

Social media

CRM follow-up

Other outreach channels



AI & Technology

You should be very comfortable with computers and interested in technology.

We use AI heavily and want someone who sees it as a tool to help them work smarter.



Experience with tools such as these is valuable:

ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

GoHighLevel

LinkedIn

Canva

Dialpad

CRM platforms

 marketing platforms

Automation tools



GoHighLevel experience is a plus, but it is NOT the main reason we will hire you.

We would rather hire someone who is smart, resourceful, great with people, technologically capable, and eager to learn than someone who knows every feature inside GoHighLevel but doesn't enjoy outreach or generating business.



Marketing & Outreach

You will also help with:

LinkedIn posts

LinkedIn engagement

Social media content

 outreach

SMS campaigns

Lead nurture campaigns

Referral partner outreach

Prospect research

Canva graphics and flyers

Basic marketing materials

AI-assisted content creation



We don't expect you to be an expert at everything.

We care much more about finding someone with the right combination of communication skills, intelligence, creativity, resourcefulness, and drive.



Who We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate is:

An excellent English speaker

Comfortable cold calling

Confident talking to strangers

Personable and professional

Smart and resourceful

Creative

Tech-savvy

Familiar with AI

Organized

Dependable

Consistent

Adaptable

Curious

A fast learner

Comfortable receiving feedback

Interested in improving instead of simply completing tasks

We especially value people who can be given a desired result and figure out how to help us get there.



Experience That Would Be Valuable

You do not need experience with everything below.

We are interested in candidates with experience in areas such as:

Cold calling

Outbound sales

Lead generation

Appointment setting

Business development

Customer service

LinkedIn outreach

 outreach

Social media

GoHighLevel

AI tools

Marketing

Home services

Must be available during Arizona business hours

Remote

Long-term position



Pay

VA BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

 Marketplace/Messenger customer communication

A renter is two days late paying.

You join a growing rental company where many procedures currently exist only in the owner’s head.

Write a short Standard Operating Procedure for:



Vehicle Return ? Vehicle Inspection ? Preparing Vehicle for the Next Renter

title: Email Strategist
description:
Momentum Marketing is a done-for-you
 and SMS retention agency for DTC ecommerce brands. We run the full retention engine end-to-end inside Klaviyo, and we back our work with a revenue attribution guarantee. We are direct, numbers-led, and allergic to agency fluff. Our clients pay us to protect their margin while acquisition costs climb, and every
 we send has to earn its place in the inbox.



We are growing, and we are hiring a copywriter who can own the copy for an entire pod of brands.



The Role



You will be the copywriter inside a pod. Each pod manages 5 to 7 brands depending on capacity and pod size, and you own all copy across every flow and campaign for the brands in your pod.



This is not a "write a few
s a week" role. You are the retention copy engine for your pod, and the pod's revenue numbers depend on your output.



What you will do

Build the campaign calendar every single month for each brand in your pod. This is a core, non-negotiable deliverable, not an occasional task.

Write all campaign copy for your pod's brands, mapped to the monthly calendar.

Write all flow copy — Welcome, Abandoned Checkout, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandon, Site Abandon, Post-Purchase, Winback, and Sunset. Post-purchase is where we expect you to be exceptional.

Structure flows strategically inside Klaviyo — you know how to set up the right conditional splits, and how to split based on buyer intent and dollar value. You do not just write copy; you know where each
 sits and why.

Complete all assigned work daily. The role does not run on fixed hours beyond the 10:00 AM daily start, but every task and duty assigned to you must be completed. Output is the measure, not hours logged.

Prerequisite: Supplement Brand Experience (Non-Negotiable)



You must have proven, demonstrable success writing for 7 to 8 figure supplement brands. This is a hard prerequisite, not a preference.



That means you understand supplement buyer psychology at a working level:



Why supplement customers buy, why they lapse, and what actually reactivates them

How to sell repeat purchase and subscription without sounding desperate

How to handle claims, ingredients, and benefits persuasively and responsibly

How to write post-purchase sequences that turn a first order into a second and third



You will be asked to show proof of work. Portfolio pieces from 7-8 figure supplement brands with real performance data (open rates, click rates, revenue attributed). If you cannot show this, please do not apply.



Manual Copywriting Only — No AI



All copy must be written by you, manually. We will know if it is written by AI.



AI copy has a tell: it cannot think, it cannot adapt to a specific region's culture and language, and it cannot make the creative word choices that make an
 feel like it was written by a human who actually understands the customer. We need a writer who can flex tone, reference culture, and choose words that land with a specific audience in a specific market.



If your workflow is "prompt, paste, submit," this role is not for you.



Skills and Knowledge Required

Copywriting: High-converting
 copy is your craft. You can prove it with numbers.

Strategy: Excellent retention strategy knowledge. You can build a monthly calendar that balances promo, content, and lifecycle, and you can explain the reasoning behind every send.

Klaviyo: Strong working knowledge. Flow structure, conditional splits, segmentation by buyer intent and dollar value, and how flow logic connects to copy.

Post-purchase mastery: This is the flow we care about most. You should be able to talk in depth about how you build post-purchase sequences that drive second and third orders.

Cultural and linguistic range: Ability to adapt copy to specific regions, cultures, and language patterns.

The Hiring Process

Application with portfolio and proof of work (7-8 figure supplement brands, with performance data)

Copy test — every candidate completes a test. Details provided to shortlisted applicants.

Interview

Culture and Expectations



Read this section carefully. We take it as seriously as the skills.



Punctuality is critical. Work starts at 10:00 AM daily. Deadlines are deadlines.

Attitude matters as much as talent. If you demonstrate a bad attitude or entitlement that affects the morale of the team, you will be terminated without notice. We mean this.

We help each other. Our culture expects you to support your pod and the wider team. No lone wolves.

Learner's mindset. There is always something you can learn. We expect you to want feedback and act on it.

Hunger. We want ambitious people who want to excel, not people looking to coast.

Compensation

Competitive base salary

Quarterly performance bonus that can exceed a full month's salary — when your pod's brands win, you win

Long-term contract with growth as the agency scales

title: Creative Strategist & GC Creator / Paid Ads Creative Strategist
description:
GO HERE:    
.      com       /      IZCONTENTCREATOR

(Only applications sent here will be processed)



About the Role



We are a growing virtual assistant staffing agency helping U.S. healthcare organizations build reliable remote teams.



We are looking for a Performance Creative Strategist & On-Camera UGC Creator to own the development of paid social creatives from research and concept development through scripting, filming, editing, and performance-driven iteration.



This is not a traditional social media content role.



Your primary objective is to create direct-response ads that generate qualified leads and booked calls at increasingly efficient acquisition costs. Creative decisions should be driven by customer insights and performance data—not aesthetics alone.



You will work closely with our marketing team, receive visibility into creative performance, identify what is and is not working, and use those insights to develop the next generation of ads.



What You'll Own



Creative Strategy & Research



Develop a deep understanding of our target audience, particularly U.S. healthcare owners, administrators, and operational decision-makers.

Research customer pain points, objections, motivations, and buying triggers.

Analyze existing winning and losing creatives to identify repeatable patterns.

Research competitor advertising, Meta Ad Library, organic content, and other sources for new hooks, angles, and concepts.

Develop creatives for different stages of customer awareness, including problem-aware, solution-aware, and product-aware audiences.

Build and maintain a library of winning hooks, angles, formats, and messaging.



Direct-Response Creative Production



Develop approximately 5–10 new ad concepts per week, with multiple hook, angle, or CTA variations where appropriate.

Write compelling hooks designed to capture attention within the first few seconds.

Write complete 30–60 second direct-response video scripts and accompanying shot lists.

Personally appear in UGC-style advertisements, including:

Talking-head videos

Walk-and-talk videos

Demonstration/explainer formats

Testimonial-style creatives

Problem/solution advertisements

Edit or assemble short-form creatives for platforms including Meta, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

Turn successful concepts into multiple creative variations rather than constantly starting from scratch.







Performance & Optimization



You will be expected to understand the performance of your creatives and use that information to determine what should be produced next.









You will:



Review creative performance weekly or biweekly.

Analyze metrics such as:

Thumb-stop / 3-second view rate

Click-through rate (CTR)

Cost per lead (CPL)

Cost per qualified lead

Booked-call performance

Customer acquisition cost (CAC), where applicable

Identify winning and losing hooks, angles, formats, and messaging.

Develop iterations based on performance rather than producing disconnected creative ideas.

Clearly explain the hypothesis behind each new creative test.

Maintain organized creative tagging and documentation so performance patterns can be identified over time.







What Success Looks Like



Success in this role is measured by creative performance and learning velocity.



Within the role, we expect:



A consistent weekly pipeline of new creative concepts and variations.

New creatives that regularly outperform existing benchmarks across engagement, click-through, lead generation, or acquisition efficiency.

At least one new scalable creative winner on a recurring basis.

Clear documentation of winning hooks, angles, objections, and formats.

Increasing reuse and iteration of proven concepts rather than relying entirely on new ideas.

Meaningful insights during creative performance reviews—not simply delivery of finished files.







Required Experience



2+ years of experience creating direct-response paid social advertising, preferably for B2B, service-based, staffing, healthcare, SaaS, or lead-generation businesses.

Demonstrable experience producing creatives specifically designed for paid acquisition—not solely organic social media content.

Strong on-camera presence and confidence delivering UGC-style or talking-head advertisements.

Portfolio demonstrating multiple direct-response video advertisements.

Ability to provide examples of creatives that contributed to improvements in metrics such as:

CPL

CAC

CTR

ROAS

Qualified lead volume

Booked calls

Strong understanding of Meta advertising creative and performance metrics.

Ability to interpret advertising data and translate findings into new creative decisions.

Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, particularly for short-form advertising.

Ability to independently research an audience and develop compelling hooks, angles, and scripts.





Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is a strong advantage:



U.S. healthcare

Virtual assistant or outsourcing services

Staffing and recruitment

B2B lead generation

Professional services

TikTok advertising

YouTube Shorts advertising





Who We're Looking For



Data-Driven



You care about whether an advertisement performs—not simply whether it looks good.





Self-Directed



Once you understand the offer, target audience, brand, and performance data, you can independently research and develop the next batch of creative tests.





High-Output



You understand that paid-social performance requires consistent testing and iteration. You are comfortable producing multiple concepts and variations every week.



Customer-Obsessed



You continuously look for new customer pain points, objections, questions, language, and motivations that can become compelling advertising angles.



We are looking for someone who wants to take long-term ownership of a growing paid-social creative program and continuously improve its performance through research, experimentation, and data.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based law firm seeking an Executive Administrative Assistant to provide dependable, high-level administrative support to the firm's day-to-day operations. This is a part-time position to start, with the potential for expanded hours, responsibilities, and a full-time role as the firm's needs grow.



The position is Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time. We are looking for someone who is interested in developing a long-term relationship with the firm and becoming someone we can rely on to keep things organized and moving forward.



This role requires more than simply completing a checklist of assigned tasks. The successful candidate will be able to manage competing priorities, notice details that others may overlook, communicate clearly and professionally, and use good judgment when handling administrative matters. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, and can increasingly work independently as they become familiar with the firm.



About the Role



The Executive Administrative Assistant will work closely with the firm's leadership and assist with a variety of administrative, organizational, and operational matters. The position will involve handling both recurring responsibilities and one-off projects, so flexibility and a willingness to learn are important.



Depending on experience and the firm's needs, responsibilities may include:



- Managing and organizing calendars, meetings, and appointments

- Preparing, editing, and formatting correspondence, documents, and other materials

- Drafting routine
s and communications based on instructions or established templates

- Maintaining well-organized electronic files and client-related folders

- Managing documents and information within Google Drive and other cloud-based systems

- Preparing forms, applications, and other administrative materials

- Maintaining spreadsheets, databases, trackers, and internal records

- Reviewing documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting, and consistency

- Conducting internet research and organizing information into useful summaries

- Assisting with client onboarding and administrative follow-up

- Monitoring deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding administrative items

- Coordinating with vendors, service providers, and other third parties as needed

- Assisting with firm projects, systems, and process improvements

- Following and helping maintain the firm's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Learning new software, systems, and processes as needed

- Providing general administrative support to firm leadership

- Handling other projects and responsibilities as they arise



As you become more familiar with the firm and our operations, we expect the successful candidate to take on greater responsibility and become increasingly proactive in identifying ways to improve efficiency and organization.



What We Are Looking For



The right person will be:



- Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities

- A strong written and verbal communicator in English

- Professional and courteous in all communications

- Able to work independently while knowing when to ask questions

- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what needs to be done

- Willing to learn unfamiliar systems and processes

- Someone who takes ownership of their work and follows tasks through to completion

- Comfortable receiving feedback and continually improving their work



Prior experience as an executive assistant, legal assistant, administrative assistant, or in another professional services environment is preferred. Law firm experience is not required, and we are willing to train someone who demonstrates the organizational ability, professionalism, and work ethic we are looking for.



Hours

- Additional hours may become available as the firm's needs develop

- Applicants must be able to consistently work during the stated Eastern Time hours



We are specifically seeking someone interested in a long-term position, rather than someone looking for a short-term or temporary opportunity.



How to Apply



Please follow all of the application instructions below. Attention to detail is an important part of this position, so failure to follow the instructions may result in your application not being considered.



Please include:

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted and integral member of our team. If you are highly organized, dependable, comfortable taking initiative, and enjoy supporting a professional environment where no two days are exactly the same, we encourage you to apply.

title: Outbound Sales & Lead Associate
description:
We are seeking a motivated and professional Commercial Cleaning Outbound Sales & Lead Associate to generate new business opportunities for our commercial cleaning services. This position will focus primarily on making outbound calls to businesses from provided lead lists to identify companies that have current or upcoming commercial cleaning needs.



The ideal candidate is comfortable speaking with business owners, office managers, facility managers, property managers, and other decision-makers. The primary goal is not necessarily to close the sale on the initial call, but to identify qualified prospects, gather information about their cleaning needs, and schedule opportunities for the sales team to follow up and provide a proposal or walkthrough.



Key Responsibilities -



- Make a high volume of professional outbound calls to businesses using a provided lead lists.

- Identify the appropriate decision-maker for commercial cleaning services.

- Introduce the company and explain our commercial cleaning services in a professional and compelling manner.

- Determine whether the business currently uses a cleaning company and identify potential opportunities.

- Identify businesses that are dissatisfied with their current cleaning provider or may be seeking a new provider.

- Identify upcoming opportunities, including new locations, renovations, office moves, or expiring cleaning contracts.

- Obtain accurate contact information for decision-makers.

- Schedule appointments, facility walkthroughs, or follow-up calls for qualified opportunities.

- Follow up with prospects when appropriate.

- Maintain a professional, courteous, and persistent approach when dealing with prospects.

- Meet established daily and weekly outbound call and lead-generation goals.



Qualifications -



- Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, inside sales, lead generation, or business development is preferred.

- Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

- Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and speaking with business professionals.

- Ability to confidently ask questions and identify customer needs.

- Professional, positive, and persistent attitude.

- Organized and able to accurately document calls and prospect information.

- Basic computer skills for notes on lead generations.

- Commercial cleaning, janitorial, facilities management, or B2B sales experience is a plus but not required.



Performance Expectations - 

Success in this position will be measured primarily by:



Outbound calls completed.

Decision-makers reached.

Qualified commercial cleaning opportunities identified.

Appointments or walkthroughs scheduled.

Accurate and complete lead documentation.

Follow-up activity and overall quality of leads generated.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who isn't afraid to pick up the phone, can handle rejection professionally, and enjoys creating opportunities from cold leads. They should be persistent without being pushy and able to quickly determine whether a business represents a legitimate opportunity for commercial cleaning services.



Primary Objective:

Generate a consistent pipeline of qualified commercial cleaning leads and appointments that can be pursued by the company's sales team.

title: Digital Marketing, Social Media Growth & Course Launch Manager
description:

We’re looking for a creative, driven and results-focused marketer to grow our online presence, create engaging content, build a strong community and convert our audience into paying students.



This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys both content creation and digital marketing, and wants to play a key role in building a fast-growing education brand. This is a results-driven role for someone who understands how to build a complete marketing system—from attracting an audience through engaging content to nurturing leads and driving course sales.



Responsibilities:



Content Creation & Social Media 

Develop and execute a social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and (eventually) YouTube.

Create and manage content plans and content calendars.

Research trends and identify opportunities to grow our brand.

Create, edit and publish engaging short-form videos and social media content.

Design graphics and marketing materials using Canva or similar tools.

Write engaging captions, hooks, scripts and calls to action.

Stay up to date with social media trends and platform updates.

Publish and schedule content across all platforms.

Manage and grow our online communities.

Monitor analytics and continually optimise content performance.

Generate leads through organic social media marketing.

Develop strategies to convert followers into paying students.

Research competitors and identify opportunities to grow our brand.



Lead Generation & Sales Funnels

Create lead magnets such as free Airbnb guides, checklists and downloadable resources.

Build and optimise landing pages.

Develop customer journeys that move people from social media to our
 list and ultimately into our course.

Improve conversion rates across every stage of the marketing funnel.

Create customer journeys that guide potential students from discovering our content to enrolling in our course.



 Marketing & Course Launches

Build and manage
 campaigns and automated nurture sequences.

Keep potential students engaged with valuable educational content.

Promote webinars, masterclasses and course launches through
.

Increase conversions through strategic
 marketing.

Develop promotional campaigns to maximise student enrolments. 



Course Launches

Assist with planning and executing successful course launches.

Organise free webinars, masterclasses or challenges to generate leads.

Coordinate launch campaigns and promotional strategies.

Analyse launch performance and recommend improvements.



Analytics & Performance

Track social media growth, engagement and campaign performance.

Monitor lead generation,
 list growth and student enrolments.

Provide recommendations based on data to improve marketing results.

Research competitors and identify new opportunities to grow the brand.



Requirements

Proven experience growing social media accounts.

Experience marketing online courses, coaching programmes or digital products.

Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Strong experience creating and editing engaging content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

Experience building sales funnels and lead generation strategies.

Knowledge of
 marketing platforms and automation.

Excellent copywriting, storytelling and communication skills.

Experience creating marketing strategies that generate leads and sales.

Highly organised, proactive and able to work independently.

Proficiency with CapCut, Canva or similar content creation tools.



Nice to Have

Experience with Kajabi, Skool, ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel or similar platforms.

Experience with Meta or TikTok Ads.

Basic graphic design skills (Canva).

Knowledge of the Airbnb, serviced accommodation, property or education industry.



Success In This Role:

Your goal is to build a marketing system that consistently attracts, nurtures and converts potential students.



The ideal customer journey is:

Social Media Content ? Free Guide or Webinar ?
 List ? Course Enrolment



Success will be measured by:

Consistent growth across our social media platforms.

Increased engagement and brand awareness.

A steady stream of qualified leads.

Growth of our
 list.

More course enquiries and student enrolments.

Successful execution of course launches and marketing campaigns.

Increased revenue generated through organic marketing.



INCENTIVES:

We offer a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, flexible remote working and opportunities for career growth as our education brand expands. High performers will have the chance to take on greater responsibility, receive regular salary reviews and earn additional bonuses based on lead generation, successful course launches and overall business growth. You’ll play a key role in building our brand from the ground up, with the opportunity to make a real impact and grow alongside the business.



Please answer the following questions in your application:

We only accept applications through our Google Form:



Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Completing the form is the first test of the job: it shows you read the post and can follow instructions.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Full-time Photographer / Videographer (Visual Content Creator) for Code One, a premium mechanical keyboard brand. PHP 35,000/month. Hybrid — you must be Makati-based (or able to reliably commute) and work in person at least one day a week in Salcedo Village, Makati. Please only apply if you meet this requirement.



At Code One, we're building a different kind of mechanical keyboard brand. Our goal is to move beyond traditional tech marketing and create visuals inspired by fashion editorials, premium consumer technology, industrial design, and modern creative culture.



We already have a strong creative direction and brand vision. We're looking for someone with the skills and visual taste to execute that vision through photography, video, and content production — and to own the production pipeline day to day.

• Handle styling, locations, props, and shoot preparation

• Direct models and talent during shoots when needed

• Produce a steady weekly flow of social media and campaign assets (stills, short-form video, product imagery)

• Edit and refine visual content for brand use

• Collaborate closely with the Head of Growth to turn creative ideas into finished visuals

• Maintain consistency in Code One's visual identity across every channel



WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

• Has a strong eye for composition, lighting, styling, and visual storytelling

• Has real experience with photography, videography, or visual content production (portfolio required)

• Understands fashion, lifestyle, and editorial aesthetics

• Appreciates minimalism and premium design

• Can take creative direction while adding their own creative perspective

• Is detail-oriented and cares about the quality of the final output

• Experience with AI creative tools is a plus, but not required



WORK ARRANGEMENT

• Full-time: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, Philippine business hours

• Salary: PHP 35,000/month

• Hybrid: at least one in-person day per week in Salcedo Village, Makati (creative reviews, production planning, shoot sessions); remote otherwise

• Reports to the Head of Growth

Editorial photography, fashion campaigns, industrial design, architecture, premium consumer technology, and brands like Apple, Nothing, Leica, COS, Muji, Aesop, or similar design-led companies.

Applications without a completed form will not be considered.

title: Regional Partnerships & Client Growth Manager
description:
About Assetara Limited

Assetara Limited is an international blockchain and digital-asset technology company. We develop technology-driven solutions and infrastructure for a global client base. As part of our international growth, we are looking for a Regional Partnerships & Client Growth Manager to build professional business relationships and support market development within an assigned region.



Position Overview

The Regional Partnerships & Client Growth Manager is a full-time professional responsible for identifying and developing B2B opportunities, managing business relationships, and representing Assetara Limited in the assigned market. This is a clearly defined leadership role with a guaranteed base salary and a transparent performance-based bonus. Compensation is based on agreed business objectives and professional performance; it is not based on recruiting employees.



Key Responsibilities

* Strategic Partnership Development: Identify, approach, negotiate, and manage B2B partnerships within the assigned region.

* Client Success & Account Management: Build trusted relationships with existing business clients, understand their needs, and coordinate timely professional support.

* Market Expansion: Research local market opportunities, represent the Company at relevant industry events, and coordinate approved regional marketing initiatives.

* Commercial Coordination: Work with internal marketing, operations, product, and compliance teams to support partner onboarding and successful project execution.

* CRM & Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate CRM records, track opportunities, and provide regular pipeline and activity reports to management.

* Compliance & Brand Standards: Follow Company policies, approved communication standards, brand guidelines, and applicable local laws and regulations.



Requirements

* Professional Experience: Demonstrated experience in business development, strategic partnerships, account management, sales, or commercial growth; experience in fintech, technology, financial services, or SaaS is an advantage.

* Industry Awareness: Familiarity with blockchain, digital assets, fintech, or technology ecosystems is beneficial. Full product onboarding and training are provided.
